Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::createSupplier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingSuppliers: Set(Supplier) = Supplier.allInstance()->select(o|o.Id = id),
		isMissing: Boolean = if existingSuppliers.size() = 0 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		if isMissing = true 
		then let newSupplier: Supplier in
		newSupplier.oclIsNew() and
		Supplier.allInstance()->includes(newSupplier) and
		newSupplier.Id = id and
		newSupplier.Name = name and
		result = true 
		else result = true 
		endif 
}
